signal: Clearstory raised a $16M Series B led by Prudence and landed Turner Construction across its jobsites, plus launched an AI change-order drafting agent

email.body1:
Jordan, saw Clearstory's $16M Series B and the Turner Construction rollout, alongside its new AI change-order drafting agent.

A raise plus a marquee logo usually means RevOps gets an aggressive coverage target before routing is ready, and signal-to-action latency quietly caps pipeline. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount, 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a pipeline gap analysis for Clearstory tied to your hiring and tech-stack signals. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.subject2: 3 things in your outbound I'd change
email.body2:
Jordan, quick follow-up for Clearstory.

Most RevOps teams have workable data but slow handoff: a signal fires and it takes days to reach a rep with a relevant message. That lag is where 50-70% of response-rate lift hides, per our own best-practice data.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I'll walk you through a teardown of your current outbound, three changes I'd make, and how the signal-to-meeting handoff gets automated so nothing sits in a queue.
email.body3:
Jordan, last bit of proof for Clearstory.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Clearstory's reply rate likely compares to other Series-B construction-tech startups. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?
email.body4:
Jordan, I'll stop reaching out on this one, but didn't want to leave you empty-handed.

If tightening signal-to-action latency isn't a RevOps priority this quarter, no problem at all. The post-raise sprint to operationalize a logo like Turner is its own kind of busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to your motion? I'll tailor it to Clearstory either way.
